en.notebookStats: {sources} substantive source notes organized into {articles} bilingual articles.
en.notebookShortDescription: Theory, probability, policies, actions, hierarchy, multi-agent evaluation, and embodied research.
en.notebookDescription: Edited guides consolidate repeated discussions, standardize definitions and equations, and connect classic readings to evaluation. Every article links to full original Markdown. Historical study notes are distinguished from verified paper evidence, derivations, and proposed experiments.
en.notebookCoverage: {guides} topic guides and {reading} literature records, backed by {unique} distinct source texts. Duplicate copies map to shared topics; empty placeholders are not published as articles.
en.notebookRouteTheory: Theory: MDPs/probability → contractions and stochastic approximation → TD/traces → policy gradients/GAE.
en.notebookRouteControl: Control: cloning/bins → Diffusion Policy → SAC/representations → goals, options, and Meta-RL.
en.notebookRouteExperiment: Experiments: benchmark selection → statistics/tuning → reproducible protocols → embodied research questions.
en.notebookPaperEvidence: Edited from uploaded notes with the available bibliographic/version information. Original paper PDFs were not rechecked and experiments were not rerun.
en.notebookEditionNotice: This is an edited, consolidated edition. Downloads retain complete source wording and formatting. Unsupported numerical claims and incorrect derivations are not adopted as conclusions.
